entries.body:
The six-tab workspace becomes a single scrollable page: Acquisition
(moved from the retired /analytics-2), Money in & out (new daily
deposits-vs-withdrawals chart over the canonical getDailyPnl series),
Revenue (house-profit ladder, GGR/NGR + wager-mix trends, measured
hold), Costs (reward stack + daily reward legs), and the day-by-day
table. The specialist views (Games, Player CRM, Cost Breakdown,
Rewards, Map) survive unchanged as deep dives behind ?tab= with links
from the section headings.

- getDailyPnl(days: 7|30|90 = 30): window parametrized through the SQL
  and cache key; dashboard consumers byte-identical via the default.
- queries/analytics-2.ts → analytics-acquisition.ts; window vocabulary
  is now AcquisitionWindow with today→7d / all→90d capping, labeled
  when it diverges.
- charts.tsx: seven-chart monolith split into RevenueTrendChart /
  WagerMixChart / RewardLegsChart; median/users/affiliate charts drop.
- /analytics-2 route deleted, nav entry + PALETTE_ORDER id removed,
  apex segment dropped, permanent redirect /analytics-2 → /analytics.
- Fixtures: analytics-2 contract replaced by analytics-acquisition
  contract (nav entry gone + redirect present + same SQL assertions);
  two tests retargeted off deleted files.
